With the input as its own guide, a = var / (var + eps). For eps = 0.01, scaled to 8 bits, eps = 0.01 x 255 squared = 650.25. Two 3x3 windows:

| Window | Mean | Variance | a | b |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat with noise | 50 | 3.11 | 0.0048 | 49.76 |
| Edge, 40 and 200 | 93.33 | 5688.9 | 0.8974 | 9.57 |

In the flat window a is near 0, so the model a I + b is almost the constant 50, the mean, and the noise is removed. In the edge window a is near 1 and b is small, so the model keeps I, and the edge stays. The output of a pixel averages a and b over all windows that hold it.
